note: Trimble County (KY) publishes its zoning only as a static PDF planning and zoning map and a zoning ordinance PDF on the county site. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygon layer was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches, the county planning page, the Equator Studios third-party portal, LOJIC services or KIPDA resources. Only a non-zoning county land use layer (zher, Trimble_Co_Current_Landuse) exists, which is not zoning districts.
